name: Installed-key TextLayoutMap fast path

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

When the editable buffer revision, normalized style runs, display projection, and layout style
match the installed `TextLayoutMap`, returning the installed map before text materialization will
remove the whole-document `Rope::to_string`, logical-line vector, row-cache clone, UTF-8 boundary
scan, and shaping work from ordinary prepaint updates.

## Scope lock

This experiment changes only the exact installed-key fast path in `layout_map.rs` and its cache
state. It does not attempt row splicing, direct lookup indexes, or viewport painting; those are
separate hypotheses.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

Run the focused Test Suite TextArea page through headed Chromium with WebGPU at DPR 1 and DPR 2.
The test performs a visible wheel-scroll action, verifies the published frame and screenshot, and
records input-to-published-frame time. Inspect the screenshot and retain the measurement JSON.

Compare against the frozen baseline TextArea action median/p95: DPR 1 534.002/593.299 ms and DPR
2 497.957/561.084 ms. The retained map must preserve rendering and interaction while source
inspection confirms the exact-key return precedes `snapshot.text()`, `logical_lines`, and
`reusable_rows`.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

Unchanged layout updates return `TextLayoutUpdate::default()` before whole-text and all-row work.
Changed source style runs or projection continue through validation and full layout preparation.
The focused WASM fixture passes at both configured DPRs with a nonempty, visibly changed scroll
result and no browser/runtime crash.

measurements.target: headed WASM WebGPU TextArea wheel action
measurements.protocol: One page-isolated 35-run Playwright process per DPR with five warmups and thirty measured samples.

reportMarkdown:
# Installed-key TextLayoutMap fast path

## Scope confirmation

This experiment added only the exact installed-key return. It compares the buffer revision and
layout style kept by `TextLayoutCache`, then compares the retained normalized source style runs
and display projection. The return is before `snapshot.text()`, `logical_lines(...)`, and
`reusable_rows(...)`; therefore unchanged updates do no whole-text materialization, logical-line
vector build, row-cache clone, boundary build, or shaping.

## WASM measurement

The focused TextArea Test Suite page passed 70/70 headed Chromium/WebGPU samples: 35 at DPR 1 and
35 at DPR 2, with five warmups and thirty measured samples in each group. There were no browser or
runtime failure diagnostics. The final screenshots showed the visible 2,000-line fixture scrolled
near its final rows and every action changed physical pixels.

| DPR | Baseline p50/p95 | After p50/p95 | Delta p50/p95 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 534.002 / 593.299 ms | 501.607 / 557.942 ms | -6.1% / -6.0% |
| 2 | 497.957 / 561.084 ms | 382.557 / 494.546 ms | -23.2% / -11.9% |

The result is a direct improvement on both measured scales, but does not yet meet the epic's
75-percent reduction target. The remaining all-row rebuild path is reserved for a separate,
atomic incremental-layout experiment.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Accept the exact installed-key fast path. It preserves the existing layout map whenever the full
layout input is unchanged and measurably improves the fixed WASM TextArea action without changing
projection, style validation, or changed-layout behavior. Continue with a separate experiment for
retained row data and incremental changed-row layout; do not combine it with the accepted fast
path change.
